plugin.name: Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact
plugin.description:
## Yu Zhao · Cultivation Artifact

A spirit-sensitive jade artifact laid out as the eight trigrams around the taiji — the taiji core is the heart of Yu Zhao.

**All eight functions unlocked**

- **Life-bound Jade Tablet (Qian)**: name, gender, height, weight, appearance, garments, spiritual root, constitution, realm, status and hidden secrets, synced with the story every turn.
- **Messaging (Dui)**: one-on-one spirit talks and group chats with unread badges.
- **Jade Notes (Li)**: folders and sealed memos.
- **World Forum (Xun)**: cultivation-world posts and comments with echo counts.
- **Market (Zhen)**: goods listings, auction house and trade orders.
- **Nebula Space (Kan)**: spirit stones, coins and stored items.
- **World Map (Kun)**: current location and recent movement tracks.
- **Artifact Mgmt (Gen)**: local system page to seal/unseal functions to save tokens, with sync diagnosis, per-function data clearing and archive export/import.

**Notes**

- Protocol data is hidden from the story text automatically; tap the home sync row or the taiji core for the sync diagnosis page.
- Bagua badges surface sync alerts, unread messages and freshly synced sections; sealed slots show none.
- The floating jade entry is draggable; long-press it or reset it in Artifact Mgmt. It stays hidden outside chat pages.
- UI language follows the app locale; "Prompt language" chooses the language of the injected prompt; sync uses the diff format by default (only +/- changed rows are output), saving tokens.
settings.info: UI language follows the app; seal unneeded features in Yu Zhao Manage to save usage. Manage has sync diagnostics, per-feature clearing, export/import; the sidebar opens Yu Zhao or restores from the lorebook snapshot. The jade entry is draggable (long-press to reset); hidden outside chats. "Prompt language" picks the prompt language; sync uses diff format, sends only recent data, archives older messages to the lorebook "Yu Zhao Archive · <chat>" and recalls them on mention, with a hard usage cap.

releaseNotes.2_2_0:
- New: Dual Jade — toggle between the character domain and the player domain from the top bar. The player domain is a private device stored only on your device; you can message the character, who naturally replies in later turns (Delivered / Read / Replied markers).
- New: Player-domain editing — notebook folders/notes, space items/currency, and market orders can be created, edited and deleted; local data, never evaluated by the model, never entering the lorebook.
- New: Forum posting — post to the world forum as yourself; posts mirror as public data, and the model may comment but never rewrite player posts.
- New: Jade tablet expanded to six groups — cultivation techniques and bonds added, at least one each; old saves are completed automatically, no migration needed.
- New: World map place registry — places known to the character, recalled on demand from the lorebook when mentioned.
- New: Market requests — post purchase requests (public data, same source as listings/auctions).
- New: Search & filter — keyword filter boxes on every list page and the message detail page; pure in-memory filtering, no data changes.
- Stability: hardened cross-domain mirror concurrency (interleaved turns can no longer overwrite newer data with stale snapshots), channel tail-trimming/dedup and model-write protection, five-tier eviction hard cap, export size validation, and immediate mirror re-seeding after wipes — 701 smoke tests green.
